name: mandrake
description: Plugins Mandrake installs: prompt-trim (always, through CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS), fancy and tui-embed (optional)

plugins.name: prompt-trim
plugins.description: Cuts the sections, attachments and tool descriptions Claude Code adds around the system prompt, and rewrites the wrappers it keeps

plugins.name: fancy
plugins.description: One render pipeline for Claude's replies: themed markdown, inline color tags, status badges and swatches; a status bar and terminal tab colors by session state

plugins.name: tui-embed
plugins.description: Terminal apps drawn inside Claude Code panes with their own keys and clicks, mandrake watch among them
